headlines.description: — Zack Wheeler struck out nine in six scoreless innings of two-hit ball, Gabriel Rincones Jr. homered for his first career hit and the Philadelphia Phillies defeated the Miami Marlins 7-0 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zack Wheeler strikes out 9 and Rincones homers for first career hit to lift Phillies to 7-0 win

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — Luis García Jr. hit a go-ahead single, Dylan Crews added a three-run homer and the Washington Nationals scored five times in the fifth inning to beat the Kansas City Royals 7-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: García and Crews key 5-run 5th inning as Nationals beat Royals 7-3

events.name: New York Mets at Cincinnati Reds

headlines.description: — Eugenio Suárez homered twice and drove in a career-high six runs, including a grand slam in the second inning as the Cincinnati Reds rolled to a 12-0 victory over the New York Mets on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Suárez homers twice and drives in 6 to back Burns as Reds rout Mets 12-0

events.name: San Diego Padres at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Dustin May took a perfect game into the seventh inning before finishing a one-hitter as the St. Louis Cardinals beat the San Diego Padres 3-0 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Dustin May perfect into 7th inning and completes 1-hitter as Cardinals blank Padres 3-0

headlines.description: — Pete Crow-Armstrong became the first major league player to hit for the cycle this season as the Chicago Cubs rallied for a 5-4 victory...
headlines.shortLinkText: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits for the cycle as the Cubs walk off the Rockies, 5-4

headlines.description: — Josh Bell hit a three-run homer in the first inning, Byron Buxton went deep for the 23rd time this season leading off the sixth and the Minnesota Twins beat the Texas Rangers 4-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Bell hits 3-run homer and Byron Buxton goes deep for No. 23 as Twins beat Rangers 4-2

headlines.description: — Colt Keith had three home runs and six RBI as the Detroit Tigers beat the Houston Astros 9-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colt Keith has 3 home runs and 6 RBIs as the Tigers blow past the Astros 9-3

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Pavin Smith hit a tiebreaking solo homer off the right-field foul pole, Ryne Nelson threw seven quality innings and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Los Angeles Angels 4-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pavin Smith's 1st homer of the season lifts the Diamondbacks over the Angels 4-3

headlines.description: — Nick Kurtz hit two homers and drove in five runs, Jeff McNeil also went deep and knocked in four, and the Athletics beat the scuffling Pittsburgh Pirates 11-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Kurtz and Jeff McNeil power the A's to an 11-2 victory over the struggling Pirates

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter Miguel Rojas launched a tiebreaking homer in the seventh inning and the Los Angeles Dodgers erased an early deficit to beat the Tampa Bay Rays 4-3 on Monday night in the opener of a six-game homestand.
headlines.shortLinkText: Miguel Rojas' pinch-hit home run in the 7th lifts the Dodgers to a 4-3 victory over the Rays
